- [Cyberpunk Floating Ramen Stall](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/cyberpunk-floating-ramen-stall): 100% self-contained Blender 4.0–4.3 procedural 3D diorama generator (579 objects, 31 shader graphs), Binary glTF 2.0 serializer, pure-Python Z-buffer Neon Bloom renderer, 240 frames (10.0s @ 24fps BT.709 lossless) RIFF/AVI 1.0 & ISO-BMFF MP4 muxer, and WebGL2 + WebAudio studio.
- [AetherSynth & Flow](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/aether-synth-flow): Native Swift 6 and Metal spatial audio synthesizer (iOS 18, watchOS 11, visionOS 2, macOS 15, AUv3) with 128-tap KEMAR HRIR UPOLS convolution, 2D/3D FDTD PML waveguides, and closed-loop Lomb-Scargle HRV entrainment.
- [FerrumKV](https://ardhyanovri.my.id/projects/ferrum-kv): Distributed RESP3 key-value store, 3-node Raft consensus engine, HNSW SQ8 vector search (173K QPS, 93.3% Recall@5), and disk LSM-tree written in pure safe Rust (std only, #![forbid(unsafe_code)], 505.7K GET/s, 0 external crates).
